description: Point this firm's payment processor at their webhook endpoint, so sales, refunds and payouts post to the books. Stripe: after manage_mcp install (Write on webhooks), no key. Others: secret_name.

provider.description: Which processor: 'stripe', 'paypal', or 'square'. Ask the owner.

secret_name.description: the name the owner's credential was stored under by collect_secret. Square and PayPal need it; Stripe only when the firm prefers a key over manage_mcp

approval_token.description: Stripe only: the approval_id a 409 handed back, after the owner approved at approval_url. Same call again with it
